pages.title: G₂ Manifold
pages.text: Seven curled dimensions with a special holonomy whose symmetry group, G2, is the automorphism group of the octonions. M-theory on such a space gives a four-dimensional world with realistic physics. The manifold is tightly folded and seems to have no inside or outside.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Combining a Calabi-Yau with an extra moduli direction and the octonions' symmetry, the Compactification Lathe produced a seven-dimensional manifold with G2 holonomy, held open by exotic matter.
